The /live/export/trades API provides a response in the following format:

200 Success

text/csv - Closed trades of the live deployments of the project.
content string
One row per closed trade. The Entry Time and Exit Time columns are in UTC.
Example 
Entry Time,Symbols,Exit Time,Direction,Entry Price,Exit Price,Quantity,P&L,Fees,MAE,MFE,Drawdown,IsWin,Order Ids
2026-10-09T14:17:04.8008663Z,"SPY",2026-10-09T18:06:03.8005312Z,Buy,670.08,672.61,10,25.3,2,-8.9,25.3,8.9,1,"	276,308"

401 Authentication Error

UnauthorizedError Model - Unauthorized response from the API. Key is missing, invalid, or timestamp is too old for hash.
www_authenticate string
